name: I + index dip RSI25 21d
description: System H + index hurdle: a stock is bought only if its 6-month return beats the best of SPY/QQQ/SMH; otherwise the money stays in the leading index. Acceptance test on the standard (corrected) data: +0.9 pts overall, every era slightly better, held-back +0.9, drawdown record unchanged; below the 2-point bar, adopted by the owner. Margins -5..+10 pts all give the same gain.
